source.title: Northern Whig, 4 June 1927, p. 8 ("Antrim Rural Council")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and votes read on the block images of the Northern Whig results of 4 June 1927 and checked against the Belfast News-Letter and Irish News of the same date

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927 (the queue's nominal date of 26 May is the statutory date, not the poll). Only the two contested divisions, Cogry and Rashee, were printed; the other divisions were returned unopposed and their names are not reproduced in the reports traced. Todd (new member), 196; Barr (old member), 133; majority 63.
